name: Paik/Abe Colorizer (Artistic Interpretation)
description: Triangle wave folding colorizer inspired by Paik/Abe aesthetics. This is an ARTISTIC INTERPRETATION, not an authentic circuit emulation.

authenticity.reason: Based on online descriptions mentioning 'folding' behavior, not actual schematics. Real Paik/Abe uses CA3019 diode array for amplitude window detection, not triangle wave folding.
authenticity.notes: The 'folding' concept was derived from loose descriptions like 'folds over or inverts high level signals'. Actual schematics (Page 28 PED.CONT) show amplitude window circuits using CA3019.

technical.approach: Triangle wave folding with per-channel gain

artistic_value.visual_character: Psychedelic rainbow banding from luminance, similar aesthetic to real Paik/Abe but via different mechanism
use_cases: When exact authenticity is not required
artistic_value.comparison_to_authentic: Produces more 'folded' appearance with sharper transitions vs. the softer amplitude-windowed look of authentic PED Control

future.reason: Valuable creative tool, just needs proper classification
future.potential_evolution: Could become basis for 'Serge-style wavefolder' or generic video wavefolder module
